meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: Claude会启动5个并行后台子代理，分别检查目标达成、代码质量、安全性、实际运行、上下文遗漏。5个全通过，审查才算通过。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求审查已完成的工作（如说“review work”、“check my work”等），或准备提交PR前，Claude会启动审查。

say.text: 检查我最近的改动是否达标。
say.note: 会对照目标与约束逐项核对。

say.text: 帮我验证这次实现有没有问题。
say.note: 所有子代理都通过才算过。

howto.what_en: Claude starts 5 parallel background sub-agents for goal/constraint check, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass for review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to review completed work (e.g., says 'review work' or 'check my work'), or right before a PR handoff.

say_en.text: Review the work I just finished.
Check whether my recent changes meet the goals.
Help me verify this implementation for issues.
say_en.note: Passes only if all sub-agents pass.
